array.string: cd "$HOME/workspace/git/igor/mac-yolo-safeguards" && /usr/bin/env node tools/stale-checkout-audit.js > "$HOME/.cache/stale-checkout-audit.log" 2>&1; node tools/stale-checkout-audit.js --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "Stale checkout" -message "A checkout an automated job runs from is stale or has unversioned work. See ~/.cache/stale-checkout-audit.log" 2>/dev/null || true
